substantiveRecoveries.finding: Full signed 2007 implementation protocol and its service instructions recovered; full signed 2025 protocol and two annexes recovered. The official newsletter describes the 2004 private-import restriction as prohibiting covered plants/products without an official origin sanitary certificate, including mainland France/EU. The current DAAF page describes a personal-import prohibition using the 1990 definitions. Neither gives an express finished manufactured tea exception. This adds historical administrative interpretation, not the unrecovered full 2004 order, and does not establish tea coverage or an unconditional prohibition.
